# Get Last Photo

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the last n photos in your library. You can optionally include screenshots or not.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getLastPhoto(count: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>, screenshots: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getLastPhoto(count: 10, screenshots: false)
~~~~
